content_sections.heading: About NEIAH
content_sections.text: The North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy (NEIAH) is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Ayush, Government of India. It is located at Mawdiangdiang, Shillong, Meghalaya.

content_sections.heading: NEIAH Residential Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Age is counted as on the date of interview, while the essential requirements and other conditions must be met as on the last date of receipt of applications. Qualification: M. Sc. (Statistics) from a recognized university. Experience: minimum 8 years of professional experience in the field of Statistics after completing the post graduate degree. Preferable: PhD qualified. Preferable: experience of working in Medical Colleges, a Health institute or any organisation dealing with Bio-medical and Public health data. Qualification: MD/MS in Ayurveda from a recognized University and duly recognized NCISM Act 2020. Experience: minimum 8 years at a Central/State Govt., Autonomous organization or Public sector body as Faculty member, Medical Officer, Consultant or SRF. Candidates must meet either of these two routes: Route 1: MD (Ayurveda) in Rasa Shastra / Dravyaguna, or M. Pharma in Ayurveda, from a recognized University and duly recognized by NCISM, with minimum 5 years of experience in Manufacturing of Medicines. Route 2: B. Pharma in Ayurveda from a recognized University and duly recognized by NCISM, with minimum 7 years of experience in Manufacturing of Medicines. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

rows.event: Last date of receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the test or interview, as the Institute deems fit. Those called may have to appear for a written test, skill test or interview at their own cost. The Director's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and allotment of posts is final and binding. If no candidate is found suitable for appointment, the post will be filled by candidates eligible for a lower level post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract, initially up to 31 March 2027. The competent authority may extend or curtail it at any time. Appointment is subject to physical fitness. Wrong information found at any stage will result in disqualification of the candidature and/or dismissal from service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEIAH Residential Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the NEIAH website . The form is also printed at the end of the notification. Fill it in completely, including your postal address, email and mobile number. Enclose the documents listed below. Write "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ..." on the envelope, adding the name of the post. Address the envelope to: The Director, North Eastern Institute of Ayurveda & Homoeopathy (NEIAH), Mawdiangdiang, Shillong, Meghalaya – 793018. Send it by Speed Post or Registered Post, or place it in the designated Drop Box. Courier is not accepted. Documents to send: Self-attested copies of all certificates, mark sheets and testimonials supporting age, educational qualifications and experience. Two recent passport size photographs. The form also has a space for a self-attested photo. For applications forwarded by a sponsoring authority or employer, a certificate that the officer is clear from the vigilance angle and that no disciplinary proceedings are pending or contemplated. The Institute is not responsible for postal delay or lapse, and applications received after the closing date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. Can a B. Pharma holder apply for Consultant (Pharmacy)?
faq.answer: Yes, if the degree is a B. Pharma in Ayurveda recognized by NCISM and the candidate has at least 7 years of experience in Manufacturing of Medicines.

faq.question: Q2. Is a PhD compulsory for the Biostatistician post?
faq.answer: No. A PhD is listed only as preferable. The mandatory degree is M. Sc. (Statistics).

faq.question: Q3. Which experience counts for Residential Medical Officers?
faq.answer: The 8 years must be at a Central/State Govt., Autonomous organization or Public sector body, as Faculty member, Medical Officer, Consultant or SRF.

faq.question: Q4. What happens if the closing date falls on a holiday?
faq.answer: The next working day will be taken as the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. How will shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: The interview or call letter will be sent by speed or registered post and by email.

faq.question: Q6. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be admissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will changes to this recruitment be published?
faq.answer: Any corrigendum or order will be issued only on www.neiah.nic.in. No separate corrigendum will be published in newspapers.

faq.question: Q8. Can the advertisement be changed or cancelled?
faq.answer: Yes. The Director, NEIAH reserves the right to make any amendment, cancellation or change, in whole or in part, without assigning any reason.
